items.text: Breece Hall (quad) is now ready to return to the field and should play Week 9 vs Chiefs after missing Sunday (and prior five games).
items.why: Progressed; Rapoport confirms good to go after limited practice and Sunday inactive.
items.implication: Hall returns as RB1 but may share with Braelon Allen who produced well in absence; both RB2/flex range possible.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry split risk; monitor practice upgrades.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (right thumb) will be placed on IR and undergo surgery after injury on first snap vs Bills; potentially season-ending. Tyler Huntley also out with toe injury.
items.why: Thumb injury requiring surgery on first play back from ankle; coach confirms IR.
items.implication: Ravens QB room depleted; Fagnano or free agent next; Henry/Flowers volume shifts, overall offense downgrade.
items.opportunity: Reduced rushing upside for Henry; possible short-term target bump for Flowers/Andrews/Likely but lower efficiency.

items.text: Jets WR routes on 35 Geno dropbacks: Garrett Wilson 34, AD Mitchell 26, Omar Cooper 26. Wilson/Mitchell/Taylor 81% target share; Cooper zero targets despite snaps.
items.why: Near-max routes and high target share.
items.implication: Wilson dominant even with Geno; locked WR1.

items.text: Raiders RB snaps: Mike Washington 38, Ashton Jeanty 25. Unclear if Jeanty out-carried 25-2 due to midweek comments, performance, or both.
items.implication: Jeanty role not secure; committee risk ROS.
items.opportunity: Monitor if Washington continues lead; Jeanty handcuff or flex only.

items.text: Steelers RB snaps: Jaylen Warren 34, Rico Dowdle 28. #FreeJaylen
items.implication: Warren preferred in PIT backfield; free him in lineups.

items.text: DJ Moore ACTIVE (along with Dalton Kincaid, Aaron Jones, Jeremiyah Love). OUT: Breece Hall, Carnell Tate, Tajae Spears.
items.implication: Clear to play after shoulder Q; startable if matchup allows.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid ACTIVE per Berry pregame report after chest Q.
items.implication: Bills TE available; target share intact.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE after prior ankle concerns; listed in Berry actives.
items.why: Berry report; ETR later watching ankle but played.
items.implication: Cardinals RB available; monitor postgame ankle re-aggravation notes.
items.conflict: ETR postgame watching list for ankle.

items.text: AJ Brown listed OUT in weekend fantasy reports summary.
items.implication: Patriots WR targets shift; check beneficiaries like others in NE.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining NE pass catchers.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed OUT alongside AJ Brown in ETR weekend reports.
items.implication: NE RB depth thins; Rhamondre or others elevated.
items.opportunity: More carries for Stevenson or backups.

items.text: Browns RB snaps: Dylan Sampson 39, Quinshon Judkins 27. Routes Sampson 28, Judkins 10 as CLE fell behind. Judkins a bet on TDs weekly.
items.implication: Judkins goal-line/TD equity but limited volume in negative scripts.

items.text: Chargers RB snaps: Kimani Vidal 28, Keaton Mitchell 19, Omarion Hampton 18.
items.opportunity: Monitor for role expansion; currently limited.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT per Berry pregame.
George Pickens EXPECTED TO PLAY in ETR weekend summary (with Waddle, Loveland, Gainwell, Price etc.).
